thread:
finn: tiny conspiracy theory: the office foil hats actually improve Wi-Fi. tested 0% scientifically. :tinfoil:
arya: scientifically chaotic is my favorite kind of science. do we have a hat guild?
devon: guild idea: weekly hat crafting at lunch. bring scissors, glue, dignity optional.
peggy: i'm in if there are stickers. mandatory sticker requirement.
ops-bot: Reminder: scissors are a shared supply. please return to Supplies cabinet after craft sessions.
finn: drafting bylaws: 1) hats may not obstruct camera during meetings 2) hats must be respectful 3) no glitter near vents.
arya: addendum: hats designated "Meeting Formal" must be worn on Fridays for morale.
devon: trying to picture a tiny hat tie-in with onboarding. new hire gets a "Starter Tin-foil" kit. low-cost, high-silliness.
peggy: craft idea: a tiny office crest on the hat. symbols: coffee cup, tiny laptop, and the sacred fern.
safety-bot: Safety reminder: do not place foil hats on hot beverages or near open flames. also, watch sharp edges.
finn: noted. we will issue a safety briefing before the inaugural Hat Luncheon. powerpoint optional. :nerd_face:
arya: vote time: :one: for weekly hat lunch :two: for monthly. react please.
devon: :one: weekly. commitment to craftsmanship.
peggy: :two: monthly. i like my free time.
finn: tally says weekly wins by passionate crafters. scheduling note: first session this Wednesday 12:15 by the big window. bring tape.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Hat Luncheon: Tin-foil Trials". automatic RSVP enabled.
arya: also thinking of a folklore element: hats get names. mine will be "The Quiet Buffer".
devon: mine is "Latency Lord". dramatic.
peggy: mine is "Snack Sentinel" and will guard the pastry table.
finn: tiny competition: best-hat title with a paper crown prize. deposit bragging rights.
safety-bot: Quick compliance note: do not attach anything to the building structure for hat displays. use freestanding props only.
devon: understood. also planning a tiny photo booth for hat portraits. will add a Polaroid-style prop.
arya: social rule: hats are consensual. do not place hats on colleagues without explicit permission. humiliation penalties are real and involve the offender making coffee for a day.
peggy: agreement. consent is the central pillar.
finn: last item: i made a tiny template if anyone wants to pre-cut shapes: https://imgur.com/hat-templates (placeholder). see you Wednesday, bring tape and jokes.
peggy: excited. will bring stickers and a small reward of leftover croissants.
devon: bringing safety scissors and a stern nod.
arya: can't wait. this will be absurdly good for team psyche.
ops-bot: Reminder: avoid glitter coronations in the HVAC ductwork.
